scope: Independent AI visual review using the original public street photographs. This is an assessment by one AI reviewer, with no human annotation claimed. No new specialist results, automatic/control assignments, requested sides or app returns entered this visual review. Existing field work included some of the photographs, so previous photographic familiarity is possible. The 16 originals were preselected by the source proposal procedure; they are not a random sample of the street gallery.

protocol.input: Only original RGB, one pictured vehicle box, a native-image point, and opaque record ID. Hide expected sides, generated-candidate/control membership and model results. For repeat readings of the same anchor and point, read once and later compare with all queried directions.
protocol.lateral_sign: Record IMAGE_LEFT or IMAGE_RIGHT for a geometrically lateral point as it appears in the original driver view. A point along the vehicle’s longitudinal axis (front or behind), even when offset horizontally in the image, is NOT_LATERAL. If vehicle orientation/ground depth prevents a reliable call, use UNCERTAIN. Record the image bearing separately to catch semantic disagreement. Vehicle-body left/right requires known orientation and is distinct from an arbitrary x-coordinate.
protocol.surface: Vacant marked parking, visibly separated curbside paving, or another distinctly vehicle-accessible parking surface may support a point. Record travel lane, parking circulation aisle, pavement occupied by an object, sidewalk/kerb/barrier, divider paint touching an ambiguous side, and unobserved/ambiguous surfaces separately. A bare pixel of tarmac and an unobstructed driving lane do not establish a distinct pull-in.
protocol.answer: A clean positive requires a directly adjacent physically lateral point, unoccupied visible ground, discernible vehicle access on the same surface, and no plainly intervening kerb/vehicle/obstruction. Explicitly mark any unresolved condition as UNCERTAIN. A control with clearly occupied area, traffic lane, disconnected path or wrong relation receives negative. When both sides are valid, count both as eligible; the passenger must choose when the request leaves the side open. Never assert whole-vehicle fit, permission to stop or personal inspection on the road.
protocol.confidence: HIGH for unambiguous near/foreground geometry from native pixels; MEDIUM for a physically strong but restricted view; LOW for uncertainty. Count high/medium separately from unresolved. Publish ordinary UI and source-only grading separately.

labels.LEFT: Evidence of a vacant accessible directly adjoining point on the image-left of the outlined vehicle.
labels.RIGHT: Evidence of a vacant accessible directly adjoining point on the image-right of the outlined vehicle.
labels.NOT: The point fails a visible location, occupancy, adjacency or lateral-relation requirement.
labels.UNCERTAIN: The scene cannot establish a clean directional side location with sufficient confidence.
